description.value: Harry's Fish & Chips is a British-inspired fish and chip restaurant that opened in 2021 in the Tsawwassen area of Delta, BC. The kitchen hand-cuts fresh local Delta potatoes daily and makes its batter, tartar sauce, and coleslaw in-house. Both dine-in and takeout are offered, with ample seating and straightforward parking according to customer reviews.
